value: Enlighten my eyes, O Christ God, lest I fall asleep in death, lest my enemy say: I have prevailed against him.
Glory: Be the protector of my soul, O God, for I walk in the midst of many snares. Deliver me from them and save me, O Good One, for You love mankind.
Now and ever: O Theotokos, since we have no boldness because of our many sins, entreat Him who was born of you, O Virgin; for the prayer of a mother is most powerful with the Master.
